channel.description: Latest articles from The Lawrence Times (lawrencekstimes.com)

item.title: Lawrence school board adds Indigenous Peoples Day as paid holiday, hears NASS report
item.description: Lawrence school board members approved calendars for 2026-2028 that include Indigenous Peoples Day as a paid holiday the same evening that they received a report on Native American Student Services. Continue reading ...

item.title: City of Lawrence staff to advise nominating Watson Park as local historical landmark
item.description: City of Lawrence staff members will soon publish a report recommending that the city add Watson Park to the Lawrence Register of Historic Places. Continue reading ...

item.title: Prosecutors lay out evidence against teens charged in Hawk shooting; murder charge against one dropped
item.description: Bar employees, students and police testified Tuesday about what happened the night of a fatal shooting last month at the Hawk, a popular bar near KU’s campus. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas House committee reshapes proposed K-12 student cellphone ban into a mere suggestion
item.description: The House Education Committee sent the full House a bill recommending, rather than mandating, that public and private schools take cellphones and other devices away from students throughout the school day. Continue reading ...

item.title: Two KU debate teams automatically qualify for national tournament
item.description: Two KU debate teams have earned automatic bids to this year's national tournament after finishing the regular season as top-16 teams. Continue reading ...

item.title: ‘Why not South Park?’ Lawrence Farmers Market gets tentative nod from city commission
item.description: A majority of Lawrence city commissioners on Tuesday indicated they generally supported a plan for the Lawrence Farmers Market to build a permanent pavilion in South Park, though they took no formal vote. Continue reading ...

item.title: Expanding construction will close 9th Street from Indiana to Mississippi Street
item.description: Ninth Street is currently blocked to all through traffic from Louisiana to Indiana Streets, and the City of Lawrence plans to extend the closure west toward Mississippi Street starting next week. Continue reading ...

item.title: CoreCivic argues to overturn injunction keeping it from housing ICE detainees
item.description: CoreCivic argued Tuesday for the right to begin holding prisoners in its closed Leavenworth facility, even as the company is working through a local permit process that could make the court case irrelevant. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence city commissioners approve historic markers to honor teens killed by police in 1970
item.description: Lawrence city commissioners on Tuesday approved historic markers to pay tribute to Rick "Tiger" Dowdell and Nick Rice, teens who were shot and killed by Lawrence police officers in 1970, despite objections from the police chief. Continue reading ...
